title: The lane-touched-tests Windows job keeps cancelling at its cap on a large merge-in diff
why: #3261 had 5 Windows cancels at the 10 min cap; the selector runs many tests on a 145-file merge-in diff.
source: Coordinator 20:04 and 20:04 CST Nov 13, from lane brief-from-step; the lane read the last 60 lines of job 132285068637 (run 43542199013). Triage read nothing.
note: Filed 20:05 CST Nov 13. Facts (coordinator): the Windows run job of lane-touched-tests.yml has timeout-minutes 10 (decision ci-job-caps, provisional, 4 runs, slowest 4.7 min). #3261 had 5 Windows cancels at that cap (runs 43532208819 twice, 43538055612 twice, 43542199013), one with both steps passing at 9:27 and cancelled at 10:02. Windows ran four install*.test.ps1 files, merge/test_launch.py, janitor/test_session_end_sweep.py and many hooks/test_*.py suites; the head of the list is unread. #3262 Windows took 0:53 (few files). Unmeasured: how many files the selector picked on #3261, and whether main merge-ins widened it. Related, not a duplicate: step lane-touched-tests-windows-cap (cap 10 to 30 min, carrier PR #3257); triage has not read whether #3257 merged, so the lane checks first whether main already holds the 30 min cap. Decision ci-job-caps (owner: generously raise time limits) rules a cancellation at a cap gets a raise; a selector change moves a check verdict, so a lane builds it. Needs a lane. Coordinator 20:08 CST Nov 13 (20:07, REST and git read): no lane needed. #3257 (30 min cap) closed unmerged; main's lane-touched-tests.yml line 72 still has timeout-minutes 10. The carrier is #3279 "Raise the lane-touched-tests run cap to 30 min (stopgap)", open, a member of combined PR #3314. Folded into lane-touched-tests-windows-cap; #3261 re-runs after #3314 lands. The unmeasured selector question (which files it picked on #3261) is not pursued.
